noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.699 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.884, Score minimum: 0.550

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. susceptibility (score: 0.884)
     - Q5 ratio: 825.13 vs bruit blanc 0.14
     - Hurst max: 1.031, Pente FFT: -0.211
  2. fliprate (score: 0.746)
     - Q5 ratio: 86.33 vs bruit blanc 0.14
     - Hurst max: 1.162, Pente FFT: -0.065
  3. flip (score: 0.746)
     - Q5 ratio: 86.33 vs bruit blanc 0.14
     - Hurst max: 1.162, Pente FFT: -0.065

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. magnetization (score: 0.715)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.931
  2. energy (score: 0.550)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.011
  3. localvar (score: 0.550)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.003
